title: Warn when the agent's model has under 64K context
description: Fabio 2026-09-24: the agent needs room to grow; floor 64K (lowered from 120K because local Ollama cannot hold 120K). (1) Test tool use (the agent probe, MpiLlmSettings) reports the model's context window and warns under 64K; the probe can use _contextWindowFor. (2) OLLAMA_AGENT_CONTEXT (services/llmEngines.mjs) moves 32K -> 64K, as long as the KV cache stays under 12 GB (an 8B model's fp16 cache is ~9.4 GB at 64K); a local agent is for 40/50-series cards with 20 GB+ anyway. Compaction already follows the window (_compactAt: 50% below 1M, 30% at 1M+), so 64K compacts at 32K.
